mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.discount_type, c.discount_value, c.minimum_order_amount, c.maximum_discount_amount, c.total_quantity, c.issued_quantity, c.starts_at, c.expires_at, c.status, c.created_by, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM coupons c

SELECT mc.id AS member_coupon_id, c.id AS coupon_id, c.name AS coupon_name, c.discount_type, c.discount_value, c.minimum_order_amount, c.maximum_discount_amount, c.starts_at, c.expires_at, c.status AS coupon_status, mc.status, mc.applied_order_id, mc.issued_at, mc.used_at FROM member_coupons mc JOIN coupons c ON c.id = mc.coupon_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupons (name, discount_type, discount_value, minimum_order_amount, maximum_discount_amount, total_quantity, starts_at, expires_at, status, created_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{discountType}, #{discountValue}, #{minimumOrderAmount}, #{maximumDiscountAmount}, #{totalQuantity}, #{startsAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE coupons SET name = #{name}, discount_type = #{discountType}, discount_value = #{discountValue}, minimum_order_amount = #{minimumOrderAmount}, maximum_discount_amount = #{maximumDiscountAmount}, total_quantity = #{totalQuantity}, starts_at = #{startsAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_coupons (coupon_id, member_id, status) VALUES (#{couponId}, #{memberId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_coupons WHERE coupon_id = #{couponId} AND member_id = #{memberId})
WHERE mc.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY mc.status ASC, c.expires_at ASC, mc.id DESC
